|notes=The published Set 5 editions are linked as [[Punishing One (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time)|Original]] and [[Punishing One (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time) (Errata)|Remastered (2006)]]. The first sheet was released 30 May 2003 and became tournament legal on 6 June. The later wording replaces the optional attrition amount from an opposing starfighter’s printed power with +3 in battle while Dengar pilots. It grants less-than-4 immunity independent of Dengar. Capacity and printed ship statistics remain. 
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154714/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards5.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards5.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006 (errata to card #49 on 14 September 2007); page 4, slip 46. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Punishing One]].
